correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the exact definitions and all quantifiers. Prime support forces the two multiplicative divisor-sum factors into a \(p\)-power and a power of two. The repunit factor argument proves \(b=1\) without computation; parity and factorization prove \(c=1\); membership bounds then give exactly \(2\le s\le A\). The converse is direct. The packaged verifier independently checks 3624 finite base cases as regression evidence only.
